# DSH BTW 0.1.6 · DSH 0.2.2-rc.1

[中文](#zh) · [English](#en)

<a id="zh"></a>

## 中文

### 体验优化与问题修复

- 对齐原生上下文和客户端接口，保留独立旁聊、历史、追问和取消。

### 其他变更

- 精确适配 DSH **0.2.2-rc.1**、Cordis **4.1.0** 与 Schemastery **3.19.0**，使用对应 SDK 与冻结依赖；Node.js 最低版本为 **24.9.0**。
- 保留已有配置、会话与插件数据；原宿主的历史固定发行继续保留。

<a id="en"></a>

## English

### Improvements and fixes

- Align native context and client interfaces while retaining independent side questions, history, follow-ups and cancellation.

### Other changes

- Target exactly DSH **0.2.2-rc.1**, Cordis **4.1.0** and Schemastery **3.19.0**, with matching SDK packages and frozen dependencies; require Node.js **24.9.0** or later.
- Preserve settings, conversations and plugin data. Historical releases remain available for their original hosts.

## 安装 / Installation

| DSH | 固定安装包 / Fixed package | 校验 / Checksums |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0.2.2-rc.1 | [DSH BTW 0.1.6](https://github.com/gulagala001/dsh-btw/releases/download/v0.1.6-dsh.0.2.2-rc.1/gulagala001-dsh-btw-0.1.6-dsh.0.2.2-rc.1.tgz) | [SHA256SUMS](https://github.com/gulagala001/dsh-btw/releases/download/v0.1.6-dsh.0.2.2-rc.1/SHA256SUMS) |

在 **插件 → 添加插件** 使用匹配的固定包。保留原 profile、配置与数据，安装后按宿主提示重载。

Use the matching fixed package in **Plugins → Add plugin**. Retain your profile, settings and data, then reload when requested.

[安装指南 / Installation guide](https://github.com/gulagala001/dsh-btw/blob/main/docs/install.md)
